reason: The patch adds isAccessTokenId to AssertEvents.java (patch lines 1118-1134). It returns false when items[0].substring(3, 5) equals expectedGrantShortcut, which is the opposite of what a matcher should do. The offset is also wrong: encodeTokenId (patch 349-352) builds the ID as session (2 chars) + token type (2) + grant (2), so the grant is at index 4-6. For example, "onrtac" gives "ta", which never matches, so in practice the matcher accepts any grant with a UUID suffix and does not reject correct tokens.
